messages:
oliver: Quick note  we've had multiple customers ask how to trace requests when a proxy impersonates a service account. Console shows billing project only.
sunita: Is this breaking quotas or just the usage UI and alerts?
oliver: Quotas/enforcement are fine. The problem is telemetry grouping: alerts point to the caller project, not the SA that executed the work.
hannah: Could auth-proxy emit an extra header, e.g. `X-RW-Effective-Principal: sa:proj-xyz/rt-sa` while keeping `X-RW-Origin`? That gives us both sides.
mike: That seems straightforward. We then need to attach effective_principal to spans and optional metric tags. Big hairy bit is cardinality.
sre-bot: Reminder: any new metric dimension needs a cardinality review and must not change historical billing ETL outputs.
sunita: UX/privacy: we must not show cross-org SA names to viewers without access. Show a blurred badge with tooltip "Principal hidden (requires access)".
hannah: Rollout idea: 1) emit header behind an internal flag for 48-72h, 2) collect cardinality samples, 3) add console column behind feature flag with access gating, 4) make alerting by effective principal opt-in.
mike: Storage approach: keep `effective_principal` as an optional dimension but only index top-K per org; bucket the rest into `sa:other`. Also emit `impersonation_chain_len` metric.
oliver: Backfill plan: when header exists in traces, run a short backfill for last 7 days to improve dashboards. Coordinate with billing so ETL ignores the new dimension unless toggled.
sunita: Security: header must be set only by our proxies (mTLS or signed token) to prevent spoofing by external clients.
sre-bot: RFC required: "impersonation-observability-and-privacy". Please include perf/cost estimates for top-K selection and storage impact.
hannah: I'll draft the RFC and attach a 30d sample of unique SA counts from logs. Mike, can you run that analysis?
mike: On it. I'll run a uniqueness pass and post counts. If unique SA count per org > threshold we'll default to rollup.
oliver: Thanks. If anyone sees alert noise after the probe flip, immediately rollback and page #eng-oncall.
sunita: Small UX suggestion: add toggle in usage table "View by: origin / effective principal" so customers can flip for debugging.
hannah: Also show a small banner when an org has many ephemeral SAs: "High SA churn  results may be grouped into 'other'".
mike: Implementation note: for chained impersonations we only surface the final principal; chain length captured as metric for ops.
sre-bot: Action items created for RFC owners and telemetry owners."
